builds.label: v1.7 official production release

changes: Adds Collection Insights as an optional Dashboard exploration view backed by Publisher-precomputed library statistics.

Adds one Latest Changes history selector for Most Recent, Last 30 Days, Last 90 Days, and All History with accurate aggregate counts and records.

builds.label: v1.5 Collection Insights schema-v3 development

Adds scan-free Client refresh and complete CSV export while preserving the Dashboard Library Viewer, artwork behavior, messaging, onboarding, and update workflow.

builds.label: v1.5 Latest Changes history filter test

Compacts the modal for scaled 1080p displays, renders every quality as a real proportional Canvas bar with exact sample-rate labels, simplifies the format donut, and displays cumulative baseline activity and recent additions from Publisher schema v2.
